title: America to Aminjikarai
desc: An ambitious girl living in the USA falls in love with a man. However, when she confesses her feelings to him, she is surprised to find out that he is married.

title: Monster
desc: Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.

title: Amma Kanakku
desc: Shanti works as a maid in several homes to give her daughter, Abhinaya, a good life. However, when Abhinaya remains lax in her studies, Shanti decides to join her school to motivate her.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.

title: Dasara
desc: In a town that is dependent on coal mining, the lives of three childhood friends turn chaotic when they get into a fight with the son of the village headman.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Sathuranga Vettai
desc: A cunning fraudster profits from deceiving numerous victims. However, trouble ensues when a criminal group seeks revenge against his betrayal.

title: L2: Empuraan
desc: Stephen Nedumpally, a mystifying leader of the crime world, must lead a double life to protect his world by rekindling some old memories.

title: Jaanu
desc: Ram and Jaanu are childhood sweethearts who meet at their school reunion after nearly two decades. Although initially awkward, they soon start recollecting their past and resolve their differences.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Inttelligent
desc: A successful software engineer becomes a vigilante following the demise of his mentor in a bid to seek revenge against those responsible for the latter's death.

title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Supreme
desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.

title: Vada Chennai
desc: A proficient carrom player sets foot in the world of crime and joins forces with local gangsters to settle their feuds. However, he decides to take them down when they plan to wipe out his locality.

title: Psycho
desc: A blind man, unable to prevent his lover's kidnapping by a psychopathic killer, becomes determined to rescue her from his deadly grasp.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.
